name: Multi-City Mogul
description: Not content with owning one town? Prove you can dominate three markets at once. Secure a controlling share of bread in three of the four cities while growing a serious balance sheet — two rival chains will fight you in every aisle.

goals.description: Reach 40% share of bread in Metropolis — the flagship market.
Reach 40% share of bread in Riverside — the mid-tier suburb.
Reach 40% share of bread in Portbay — the coastal working-class town.
Grow corporate value to $40M — empires require capital.
